During the two-day visit, President Putin will hold talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi tomorrow. Both leaders will exchange views on regional and global issues of mutual interest. item.title: Chaos continues at airports as over 300 IndiGo flights cancelled
item.description: Over 300 IndiGo flights were cancelled on Thursday as chaos continued at major airports across India, with the carrier struggling to adapt to stringent new crew rostering rules. On Wednesday, the airline cancelled at least 150 flights and announced that it had initiated “calibrated adjustments” to its schedules for the next 48 hours. item.title: Cough syrups sold without prescription in Ahmedabad despite ban after Chhindwara tragedy
item.description: Despite the death of 14 children in Madhya Pradesh’s Chhindwara district due to toxic cough syrup, Gujarat continues to see blatant violations of rules meant to prevent such incidents. Even after the Centre issued clear instructions mandating that cough syrup must not be sold without a doctor’s prescription, medical stores in Ahmedabad and across the state are openly selling it over the counter. item.title: India thrash Switzerland 5–0 to enter FIH Junior World Cup Quarterfinals
item.description: In Men’s Hockey, India thrashed Switzerland 5-nil to qualify for the quarterfinals of the FIH Junior Hockey World Cup 2025 at Madurai International Hockey Stadium in Tamil Nadu. Manmeet, Sharda Nand Tiwari and Arshdeep Singh found the net for India. The hosts finished on top of Pool B with nine points from three games. Sharda Nand was awarded the Player of the Match. item.title: Bomb threat forces emergency landing in Ahmedabad, authorities detain key suspect.
item.description: An IndiGo flight (6E 058) from Medina, Saudi Arabia, to Hyderabad, India, made an emergency landing at Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport in Ahmedabad on December 4, 2025, due to a bomb threat issued by a passenger on board.
